types.label: AgencyBloc internal consistency (Individual ↔ Policy)
types.description: Find clients in the Individual report missing from the Policy report and vice versa, and surface mismatches in agent, plan, status, or effective date.

types.label: AgencyBloc internal data quality rules
types.description: Run the 10 AB-only consistency rules across Individual + Policy reports (type/status, policy combinations, identifier identity, date ordering, missing signing agents, pending-too-long, backfill suggestions, etc.).

types.label: AgencyBloc ↔ United Healthcare Book of Business
types.description: Compare AgencyBloc Individual data against UHC's Book of Business. Surfaces policies missing from either side and field mismatches. Treats UHC as source of truth: any UHC-active member missing or inactive in AB is flagged.

types.label: AgencyBloc ↔ Humana Book of Business
types.description: Compare AgencyBloc Individual data against Humana's Book of Business. Humana's per-policy event history is collapsed to the latest event per policy before comparison. AB and Humana intentionally hold different policy numbers, so policy_number is NOT used as a match key here.
